column1: # Use a fixed hub save with the Slosher equipped and the default camera, stored locally at saves/slosher-hub beside the build folder.
# The title input uses presented frames so loading time does not move the attacks into the title screen.
# Alternate attacks with swimming in the painted floor to refill ink throughout the measuring window.
# Animated ink varies at wall-clock screenshot times, so this route compares timing, reach, errors and memory without screenshot hashes.
